you_should_know.title: Colorado Bureau of Investigation says no evidence to change Megan Trussell's cause of death
you_should_know.summary: The Colorado Bureau of Investigation says there is no evidence to change the cause of death of Megan Trussell, the University of Colorado Boulder student found dead in Boulder County, from being listed as suicide.
you_should_know.description: The Colorado Bureau of Investigation says there is no evidence to change Megan Trussell's cause of death from being listed as suicide.
